title: Shakespears Sister · Stay
description: The complete supplied video: two contrasting singers, a brass bed, a silent patient, blue pillars, Earth and stars, the luminous curtain tunnel, bedside struggle, revival and final embrace. Original music with physical mouth-engine vocals.

characters.name: Marcella · the bedside voice
characters.role: The high pleading lead · physical mouth

characters.name: Siobhan · the dark answer
characters.role: The lower threatening reply · physical mouth

cues.speaker: marcella
cues.text: If this world is wearing thin,

cues.speaker: marcella
cues.text: Just wrap me up in chains

cues.speaker: marcella
cues.text: But if you try to go all alone

cues.speaker: marcella
cues.text: In the silence of your room

cues.speaker: marcella
cues.text: In the darkness of your dreams You must only think of me

cues.speaker: marcella
cues.text: There can be no in between

cues.speaker: marcella
cues.text: When your pride is on the floor

cues.speaker: marcella
cues.text: I'll make you beg for more

cues.speaker: siobhan
cues.text: You'd better hope and pray That you make it safe back to your own world

cues.speaker: siobhan
cues.text: You'd better hope and pray that you'll wake one day in your own world

cues.speaker: siobhan
cues.text: Cause when you sleep at night they don't hear your cries in your own world

cues.speaker: siobhan
cues.text: Only time will tell if you can't break the spell back in your own world
